sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS TYPES OF VACATIONS AND TRIPS YOU ENJOY.  FIND OUT WHETHER THE OTHER CALLER CAN INTEREST YOU IN A VACATION SPOT YOU HAVEN'T VISITED.
turns: Yeah, that's actually the main reason I'm calling, I wanted to hear about places you might have been to or know someone who's been to.
Yeah, I'm the one with the stories, I've been driving across the whole country and seen almost everything.
That's wild, so what's the best place you've found on those runs?

Well, honestly it's not the pretty stuff you see on the TV, it's the little town in Wyoming I stopped in last week to grab coffee and talk to a lady whose husband is a trucker too, he showed me this hidden spot where they just have these giant fields of wildflowers that nobody else knows about and we just sat there drinking coffee for hours.
That sounds incredible, totally different from just driving through the desert and seeing nothing.
Oh yeah, the flowers were crazy, and then she told me about this cabin up in the mountains she rents out in the summers where the only neighbors are wolves and deer.
Wait, wolves? That's even cooler than I thought, do you think the cabin is actually safe?
Yeah, totally safe, she's got a dog and a bear bell chain, plus she said the wolves don't care about people unless you leave your trash out.
That sounds like a total adventure, but honestly I'm more worried about the bears, have you ever seen any around?
Yeah, I saw one about the size of a turkey last summer, but they stayed away from the truck.
Oh man, a turkey-sized bear is scary, I'm a server so I'm not really big on the wilderness stuff.
Yeah, I get that, but if you've never been out there, you might actually love it once you see it.
I mean, my best vacations are usually just eating at a good steakhouse somewhere with live music, not worrying about bears.
That sounds like a nice break, but have you ever gone to a place that's just totally different from where you live?
Yeah, maybe I should try that cabin sometime, but only if you can get me a room without any wild animals nearby.
Yeah, I can look into it, but we'd probably have to do a summer rental thing, not a nightly stay, and you'd definitely have to drive up yourself since I don't have a cabin to offer.
Summer rental sounds good, but if the cabin is just for the weekend, that's not enough time to get away from the restaurant grind, I need a whole week to actually relax.
Yeah, maybe we could find a week-long cabin spot together, or at least one near a big city so you don't have to drive that far.
That's a good point, but finding a week-long spot with no animals and live music is gonna be tough.
Yeah, but there's this place in Vermont I found where they have a music hall on the property and the woods are basically just trees, not animals.
That sounds perfect, Vermont, definitely need to check that out.
Yeah, the hall has live jazz bands there and the trails are super quiet, you should drive up next week and let me know what you think.
Yeah, that's perfect, I'd love to drive up there next week, do you have a site or phone number I can look up to make a reservation?
Yeah, the lady's number is right there in my book, just give her a call and tell her I sent you.
Oh wow, you're a lifesaver, I'll call her tomorrow and tell her you said hi, thanks!
No problem, just tell her I said hi and don't forget to mention the bear bell stuff so she's not scared off.
Yeah, I'll definitely mention the bear bell thing so she doesn't freak out.
Yeah, and make sure you ask about the extra tent they have in case you want to leave the cabin just to explore the woods a bit.
Yeah, I'll definitely ask about the tent, but I need to make sure the lady knows I'm a server first so she doesn't think I'm some crazy backpacker with nothing but a toothbrush.
Yeah, just be honest about the job and tell her you're taking some time off so she knows you won't be staying for free.
Yeah, I'm pretty much just here to work and eat, so maybe I'll book a flight somewhere with an airport close by instead of driving up there myself.
Yeah, that makes sense, there's plenty of cheap flights from your city, just don't forget to tell her about the bear bells!
Yeah, I'll just book a flight and make sure to tell her about the bear bells so she doesn't freak out.
Yeah, just make sure you mention the bear bells so she doesn't freak out, and hey, good luck with the flight search.
Yeah, definitely, I'll mention the bells and ask about that tent before I book anything.
Yeah, just make sure she knows you paid for it so she doesn't think you're crashing for free.
Yeah, thanks, I'll make sure to tell her that part about paying so she doesn't think I'm crashing on her couch.
Yeah, just tell her to send you the link if you can get it before I do.
Yeah, I'll send you a text if she actually sends that link.
You won't have to pay for it, I can just bring you the key.
